notes: Single firsthand historical disenchant of a rare Midnight Harandar daily-reward Focus. Independently confirmed itemID 259349: https://www.wowhead.com/item=259349/blossoming-rootwardens-focus. One shard described (singular), but exact output quality ID among 219949/219950/219951, item bonuses, profession skill, spec and client build unknown. Blizzard Mar 18 2026 fix https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24266320/hotfixes-march-13-2026 states this item should now give Midnight materials. Cross-expansion pre-fix anomaly ONLY; not TWW gear yield/current eligibility, and do not merge with separate Mar 17-19 author's Refulgent Crystal reports. Reference-only.
